a.t: About 200 hours: PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer all put the Platinum at roughly 200 hours in one playthrough.

b.t: 300 hours or more: Push Square says to set aside up to 300 hours or more, and Leonida Unlocked notes no official time exists at all.

disputes.topic: How long does the Platinum take?

verdict.t: Our call: plan on 200 hours, budget 300. The 200-hour figure comes from the most detailed roadmap; Push Square's 300 is a cautious upper bound.

a.t: One potentially missable trophy: PowerPyx and GTABase flag only Positive Mental Attitude, for the Chapter 1 balcony meditation.

b.t: More windows exist: TechWiser, via EGamers, says the stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have story-linked windows, and Leonida Unlocked says no major outlet has published a verified missable list.

disputes.topic: How many trophies can you miss?

verdict.t: Our call: only one confirmed at-risk trophy, but start every stranger chain as soon as it appears and keep chapter-start saves.

a.t: Chapter 4: PowerPyx ties the final mission to Chapter 4's Starting From Zero.

b.t: Chapter 5: Insider Gaming words the trophy as Complete Chapter 5, and EGamers notes Beebom and CULTR word it the same way.

disputes.topic: Which chapter holds the final mission?
disputes.trophy: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

verdict.t: Our call: the official description says only 'the final mission', so play through Chapter 5 and it pops either way.

a.t: Silver: the official list, Exophase, GTABase and GamesFuze all grade it Silver.

b.t: Bronze: Push Square's per-trophy block lists Maximum Withdrawal as Bronze.

disputes.topic: Is Maximum Withdrawal Silver or Bronze?

verdict.t: Our call: Silver. The official list and every tracker agree; Push Square's block is an error.

a.t: 18 spots: PowerPyx, Push Square and KeenGamer all say the trophy needs all 18 Meditation Spots.

b.t: 15 spots: the 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18 meditations, and EGamers notes the two numbers disagree.

disputes.topic: Does the trophy need 18 meditations or 15?

verdict.t: Our call: do all 18. The 15 is the checklist threshold, not the trophy's requirement.

a.t: 8 garages: KeenGamer and Gamemapa say there are 8 purchasable garages, around $160,000 in total.

b.t: 12 garages exist: EGamers says the 4 story garages do not count, so the game holds 12 garages but the trophy needs 8.

disputes.topic: How many garages does Little Boxes need?

verdict.t: Our call: buy the 8 purchasable garages in the Vice City Real Estate app; story garages do not count.

a.t: 12 ranges: PowerPyx, GTABase and Gamemapa put the 42 challenges across 12 shooting ranges.

b.t: 2 locations: Push Square names two range locations, Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin in Balsero.

disputes.topic: How many shooting ranges are there?

verdict.t: Our call: 12 ranges hold the 42 challenges; Push Square names two of them, not all.

a.t: Closer to 60% true completion: PowerPyx says most side quests are not required and collectibles only partly.

b.t: Almost everything: Push Square says you must see and do almost everything to reach 100%.

disputes.topic: How lenient is the 100% checklist?

verdict.t: Our call: PowerPyx's numbers win — the checklist is lenient, with most side quests not required.

a.t: Unknown: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown and KeenGamer says the exact trigger is still being confirmed.

b.t: Earnable: Exophase already tracked 0.17% of players earning it by 21 Nov 2026, so a method exists.

disputes.topic: Is In The Beginning… solved?

verdict.t: Our call: unsolved in print but demonstrably earnable — re-check the guides before your cleanup run.

a.t: Unknown: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown and KeenGamer says the exact method is still unconfirmed.

b.t: Showroom window: GTABase, via EGamers, thinks it involves crashing a car out through a showroom window.

disputes.topic: How does Capital Offense work?

verdict.t: Our call: the showroom-window theory is the only lead and it is unconfirmed.

a.t: UFO questline: PowerPyx believes the trophy comes from a UFO questline.

b.t: A strange event: GTABase, via EGamers, thinks it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida.

disputes.topic: What triggers The Truth Is Out There?

verdict.t: Our call: both theories are unconfirmed; Exophase shows 0.72% earned, so keep playing and re-check the guides.

a.t: Payday Loans: PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.

b.t: No theory: KeenGamer and Gamemapa list it as unconfirmed with no suggested method.

disputes.topic: What triggers Bad Luck, I Guess?

verdict.t: Our call: the Payday Loans lead is the only one and it is unconfirmed.

a.t: Motorcycle kick: PowerPyx believes it is from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.

b.t: No theory: KeenGamer and Gamemapa list the precise method as still being confirmed.

disputes.topic: How does Ten Pin work?

verdict.t: Our call: try the motorcycle kick; the method is unconfirmed.

a.t: Unknown animal: PowerPyx and EGamers both say it is unconfirmed which animal unlocks the trophy.

b.t: Decks cover it: Bret's 15 Target Decks are required for 100% anyway, so the trophy should pop during his questline.

disputes.topic: Which animal does Fair Game need?

verdict.t: Our call: work through Bret's Target Decks; the exact animal is still unknown.

a.t: 500 actions: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and Gamemapa all put the count at 500 Criminal Profile actions.

b.t: Single source: EGamers notes the 500-action figure rests on a single source.

disputes.topic: Is Actions Speak Louder really 500 actions?

verdict.t: Our call: 500 is the working number — and the trophy's own counter in-game shows your progress.

a.t: Max Strength for both: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTABase say the trophy needs maximum Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time.

b.t: No method given: Push Square and Mobalytics list the trophy with only its vague description.

disputes.topic: How does Personal Best work?

verdict.t: Our call: the Strength method is well attested; the silent guides simply have not filled it in yet.

a.t: Kolt & Associates: the official description names the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.

b.t: Kingpin Bowling: PowerPyx and Gamemapa name the site Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.

disputes.topic: Which bowling alley is it?

verdict.t: Our call: the same place — Kingpin Bowling is the site and the trophy text names its owner.

a.t: Fly 1 km away: PowerPyx, Gamemapa and GTABase all say the trophy pops 1 km from the airport.

b.t: No distance given: KeenGamer describes stealing a departing passenger aircraft with no distance.

disputes.topic: How far must you fly for Catch Me If You Can?

verdict.t: Our call: fly 1 km away — the distance is attested by three guides.

a.t: Mile Zero Air Station: PowerPyx and Gamemapa place the tanks at Mile Zero, the south-west island.

b.t: No location: KeenGamer gives no location and GamesFuze calls it 'a secret involving a Rhino tank'.

disputes.topic: Where is the tank for Challenging Tank?

verdict.t: Our call: Mile Zero Air Station is the confirmed spot.

a.t: Snap Gun required: PowerPyx and Gamemapa say the Snap Gun from Chapter 3 unlocks the stealth entry.

b.t: No method given: Push Square lists the trophy with no method at all.

disputes.topic: Does Sneakthief need the Snap Gun?

verdict.t: Our call: finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first for the Snap Gun, then use the back door.

a.t: 250 stunts: the official description and every guide put the trophy at 250 stunts.

b.t: 300 stunts: the 100% checklist needs 300 of the 397 stunts.

disputes.topic: Does Cunning Stunts need 250 or 300 stunts?

verdict.t: Our call: not a conflict — two different thresholds. Keep going to 300 for the checklist.

a.t: Four confirmed: PowerPyx and GTABase confirm Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count toward the 8 strands.

b.t: Rest unconfirmed: the same guides say the remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed.

disputes.topic: Which stranger strands count?

verdict.t: Our call: finish the four confirmed strands first, then check the trophy's progress counter.

a.t: Yasmani pays most: PowerPyx and EGamers say Yasmani in Vice City pays the most for marked bills.

b.t: Any contact counts: the official text says only 'through your contacts', and KeenGamer says the total is cumulative.

disputes.topic: Which fence should you use for Dime on the Dollar?

verdict.t: Our call: any fence counts toward the $250,000; Yasmani is the best-paying choice.

a.t: Masked: PSN publishes the name as T**s Ass Drug Money, and Exophase and Insider Gaming print it that way.

b.t: Unmasked: GamesFuze and GTASixInsider print the name without asterisks.

disputes.topic: Is the Chapter 2 trophy name masked?

verdict.t: Our call: use PSN's masked form; the unmasked form is the same trophy.

a.t: Top Of The World, Ma: PSN's list capitalises Of and Ma.

b.t: Top of the World, Ma: Push Square and Mobalytics print it in sentence case.

disputes.topic: How is Top Of The World, Ma capitalised?

verdict.t: Our call: PSN's capitalisation is official.

a.t: 89 named: Push Square and PowerPyx count 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures.

b.t: 100 needed: the trophy needs 100 scans, so No Flusher tags must make up the rest.

disputes.topic: Do the WAiNK categories add up to 100?

verdict.t: Our call: scan No Flusher tags too — the three named categories total only 89.

a.t: 42 drone races: PowerPyx and EGamers count 42 races across the 14 locations.

b.t: 42 time trials: KeenGamer calls the same events Drone Time Trials.

disputes.topic: Drone races or drone time trials?

verdict.t: Our call: the same 42 events under different wording.

a.t: Train tunnel: PowerPyx and Gamemapa call the tunnel north of Ambrosia the easiest escape.

b.t: Automatic: the same guides say it pops on its own during bank vault robberies.

disputes.topic: Best way to escape for Hot Together?

verdict.t: Our call: both are true — use the tunnel if it has not popped by the vault robberies.

a.t: Delayed pop: PowerPyx and Gamemapa say the trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop.

b.t: Fourth shop: PowerPyx and EGamers say to rob a fourth shop if it does not pop.

disputes.topic: When does Retail Therapy pop?

verdict.t: Our call: wait 30 seconds after the third shop, then hit a fourth if it still has not popped.

a.t: Gang members only: PowerPyx and Gamemapa say it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians.

b.t: No restriction stated: KeenGamer and GTABase give no target restriction.

disputes.topic: Which enemies count for Gunslinger?

verdict.t: Our call: use gang members at illegal operations — the restriction is PowerPyx's observation.
